endorsements.quote: Importantly, AI-assisted prediction should be viewed as a complementary tool rather than a replacement for clinical judgment.

Future research should prioritize multicenter collaborations, standardized imaging protocols, and prospective validation studies to establish robust and generalizable predictive models suitable for clinical application.
Clinicians must be able to understand and evaluate the factors underlying algorithmic recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Establish appropriate regulatory frameworks and continuous performance monitoring to ensure safe and responsible implementation of AI.
Standardize CBCT imaging acquisition protocols and segmentation methods to improve reproducibility of radiomic features across institutions.
Give careful consideration to patient privacy, data security, algorithmic bias, and legal accountability in AI deployment.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article presenting a conceptual framework (Implanomics) discussing radiomics and AI integration into oral implantology workflows.
